channel.title: Pier & Point · Bayfront Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Bayfront Park (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Bayfront Park: The summary said roughly 5.5 acres; the cited sources say 5.4 acres (SF.gov) or over five acres (the Port), so it now says 5.4. It said benches and sculptures were made from reclaimed Bay Bridge steel; SF.gov says shade structures and other site furnishings. The opening milestone no longer names '16th Street Plaza', which the release does not. The map notes no longer say the OpenStreetMap shape was confirmed by a Port operator tag and Wikidata id (it has only operator:wikidata for the Port's item) and now list its actual tags; the contrast with Community Facilities District parks was removed, and the P-number note no longer calls Lotus Water the landscape architect. The claim that the park occupies plan parcels P21 and P22 is not stated by any cited source and remains unconfirmed pending a check against the Design Controls Plan map. The Wikimedia aerial's credit names only the Commons username Firstcultural.
